activity.notes: Tarenorerer (also known as Walyer) organized and led armed Aboriginal resistance in northern Tasmania from 1828 until her capture in 1830. ATLAS does not model all Palawa as a single centralized state; the Polity label identifies Tarenorerer's specific inter-band resistance force.

sources.title: Australian Dictionary of Biography — Tarenorerer (Walyer)
sources.citation_text: The Australian Dictionary of Biography records that Tarenorerer gathered men and women from several bands in 1828 and initiated organized warfare against colonial invaders before her capture in 1830.

sources.title: Companion to Tasmanian History — Tarenorerer / Walyer
sources.citation_text: Tasmanian historical scholarship treats Tarenorerer as a major leader of Aboriginal armed resistance during the Black War period.
